ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

5. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   B. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Purity of Actions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on dressing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on planting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Stories of Prophets: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Taqwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
